Top-up 2026-11-05: REFERENCE TOTAL (active businesses in Israel): 711,465 active businesses and 4,321,627 employee jobs in 2024 (grade A, a government statistic), per the Central Bureau of Statistics release 'Business Demography 2022-2024' dated 2025-08-07: https://www.cbs.gov.il/he/mediarelease/DocLib/2025/250/29_25_250b.pdf - the PDF was opened (no PDF reader here, so its text objects were decoded locally; the totals appear in the summary line and in the table, where 486,689 + 190,884 + 17,739 + 16,153 = 711,465; Hebrew words in that decode come out reversed). The same release gives 84,006 new businesses in 2024 (6.8% of all active). Also: 697,000 active businesses in 2023 per the CBS as quoted by ice.co.il on 2025-01-14 (opened): https://www.ice.co.il/consumerism/news/article/1046820 ; about 731,600 in 2025 per Maariv, 2026-07-30 (opened; the article names no source): https://www.maariv.co.il/economy/israel/article-1350420 . The CBS counts a business as active if it had positive activity in at least one month of the year (protocol.co.il, opened: https://protocol.co.il/business-demography/). For scale: Grow's 100,000+ businesses is about 14% of the 2024 count and morning's 170,000 about 24%; any figure labelled 'businesses' above about 711,000 cannot be Israel-only, and the existing smoove claim (200k-900k businesses and companies) sits close to the whole market, so it deserves a check.
FORMAT NOTE: each user_updates entry carries 'users' as asked, plus optional keys for the merger: 'sources_add' (sources to append to the existing row), 'owner_or_parent', 'public_company', 'why_israeli_add', and 'replaces_existing': true where it overrides an existing figure (grow-meshulam C to B, hilan C to D).
METHOD: SEC figures were read in the filings themselves (EDGAR company search, full-text search for the document name, then the document in 100k-character chunks). Hebrew press and company pages were opened one by one. JS-rendered Israeli sites that returned 403, empty shells or Cloudflare/Incapsula waits to plain fetches were read in the built-in browser pane as an ordinary visitor (scrolling so the page's own counters run); no challenge was bypassed (Beecomm refused to load at all). Google Play download brackets (D, unit downloads) were read from the rendered store pages on 2026-11-05; they count app installs, not customers or users.

(5) PayBox ownership is as of June 2024 (Discount was negotiating to buy Shufersal's stake). (6) The Michpal deals for Interspace-Tranzila (70%, NIS 80M valuation) and Makano/Meckano (70%, about NIS 66M) are as reported on 2026-08-20/26; closing was not checked. (7) The 'url' of global-e and jfrog is the well-known company domain, not opened (the filings were); bit-hapoalim uses its Google Play listing as url because bitpay.co.il redirect-looped in a plain fetch. (8) Linet and Z-Credit are new rows with no user figure (Linet shows testimonials only; Z-Credit's real domain is z-credit.com, not zcredit.co.il, and shows no counts); Dibs and Yad2 are new rows whose only figure is a Google Play download bracket (D, installs not users), and Yad2 is a classifieds marketplace with paid business ads rather than business software in the strict sense - drop them if the page should keep only rows with a customer or user count. (8b) Fundbox's 150,000 small businesses (press release of 2025-11-19) was read in a search-result excerpt because the syndication page failed the TLS handshake; Calcalist Tech (opened, 2021-11-30) supports the Israeli identity and gives an older, wider 325,000 'connected with' figure. Snyk has only a low-confidence tracker figure (Latka 5K, undated, unsourced), used as D; Forter, Nevo, PayMe, Rivhit, Rav Messer and Tor4You had no usable public figure (searches and pages opened gave no counts). (9) Several ranges for 'thousands' (2,000-9,000) and 'hundreds of thousands' (200,000-900,000) follow the earlier convention and are our reading of the wording, labelled in each note.
